[Intro]
[E]
Hey

[Verse 1]
[E]porter! Hey
porter! Would you
tell me the time?
How much longer will it
be till we cross That
[F#7]Mason Dixon
[B7]Line? At
[E]daylight would ya tell
that engi-
neer To slow it down?
[A]Or
better still, just
[E]stop the train 'Cause I
[B7]want to look around
[E]
Hey

[Verse 2]
[E]porter! Hey
porter! What
time did you say?
How much longer will it
be till I can
[F#7]See the light of
[B7]day? When
[E]we hit Dixie will you
tell that engi-
neer To ring his
[A]bell? And ask
everybody that
[E]ain't asleep To stand
[B7]right up and
[E]yell

[Solo 1]
[E]
[F#7]
[B7]
[E]
[A]
[E]
[B7]
[E]
Hey

[Verse 3]
[E]porter! Hey
porter! It's
getting light out-
side
This old train is
puffing smoke And I
[F#7]have to strain my
[B7]eyes But ask
[E]that engi-
neer if he will Blow
his whistle
[A]please 'Cause I
smell frost on
[E]cotton leaves And I
[B7]feel that Southern
[E]breeze
Hey

[Verse 4]
[E]porter! Hey
porter! Please
get my bags for me
I
need nobody to tell
me now That
[F#7]we're in Tennes-
[B7]see Go
[E]tell that engi-
neer to make that
Lonesome whistle
[A]scream We're
not so far from home
[E]So take it ea-
[B7]sy on the
[E]steam

[Solo 2]
[E]
[F#7]
[B7]
[E]
[A]
[E]
[B7]
[E]
Hey

[Verse 5]
[E]porter! Hey
porter! Please
open up the door
When they
stop the train I'm going to
get off first 'Cause I
[F#7]can't wait no
[B7]more Tell that
[E]engineer I said
thanks a lot And I
didn't mind the fare
[A]I'm going to
set my feet on
[E]Southern soil And
[B7]breathe that Southern air
[E]

[Outro]
[E]
title: Hey Porter
